terms.definition: An object that absorbs all the radiation incident on it; it is also the best possible emitter.
All bodies emit and absorb infrared radiation; the hotter the body, the more it emits per second.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. The intensity and wavelength distribution depends on temperature.

terms.definition: A body at constant temperature absorbs radiation at the same rate as it emits it.
Depends on the balance of radiation absorbed and emitted, including what the atmosphere reflects or absorbs.
